source_manifests.policy: references existing immutable manifests; no request/receipt bytes rewritten

frozen_error_budget.time_output: each <= one quarter of total gate
frozen_error_budget.status: pre_registered_before results; consumer calibration still required to freeze final observer thresholds

priority_order.reason: lowest pair cost; F1 coarse mass diagnostic within 1%, fine remains marginal; first family calibration
low pair cost with explicit moving-obstacle control and late-event window; exact source motion dependency retained
first adaptive-acceleration family source; long 8.35 s window and acceleration dependency require actual dt/observer evidence
first corrected F5 effective-control source; actual CLI tmax=16 s versus XML TimeMax=26 s must remain explicit
second drop case after F4-S1; 1.2 s full window and dense output are comparatively bounded
F1 second geometry with 4 s endpoint; coarse mass hard-fail retained, no threshold widening
rigid-body angular release; body mass/center/inertia must stay separate from 5120 kg SPH sample mass
large 4 s offset open-rim source; high raw footprint, preserve source-only mass and motion semantics
second pitch/acceleration source; shares particle scale but not physical control identity with F3-S1
second F5 motion source; same exact source family geometry but distinct motion dependency and full 16 s window

manifest_home_snapshot.scheduler_authority: primary parent; no lease or GPU reservation created

resource_planning.concurrency: serial full pair; no simultaneous same/half pair reservations unless parent rebalances storage
resource_planning.retention: preserve raw native; streaming observer/selected typed anchors are separate; no deletion or overwrite
resource_planning.cost_basis: actual source Part_0000 bytes × actual requested frame count with manifest safety factors; archive ratio is two-frame canary only
resource_planning.wall_and_gpu: UNKNOWN_UNTIL_PARENT_GUARDED_SOLVER; source runtime is a reference proxy, not an upper bound

calibration_contract.same_cfl_and_half_cfl: both required at original source dp for dt/time separation
calibration_contract.output_cadence: dense cadence from each exact source recipe; downsampled output is a derived observer plan, not an additional CFD run
calibration_contract.common_time: use physical query times and actual saved-time brackets; never pair frame indices across runs
calibration_contract.full_windows: per-sentinel terminal/late-event windows remain required; common [0,1] only cross-family intersection
calibration_contract.actual_dt: record RunPARTs saved-window min/max and DtAllInfo/alldt evidence; do not infer full per-step trace from CFL
